description: a cylinder of radius 3 from z 0 to 4 capped by the spherical dome of radius 5 about the origin, revolved whole about z, the two meeting at the rim at an interior angle of π − acos(0.6) (the sphere's normal there (0.6, 0.8) in the section), the rim chamfered at d 0.5: a cylinder against a sphere centred on its axis along a parallel, convex, the chamfer a cone coaxial with both through the circle d down the cylinder and the circle on the sphere at the chord d from the rim (ADR-0036 §2), with no ends, both faces' seams shortened to their contacts. The closed forms are the part's less (or, concave, plus) the corner's section swept about the axis by Pappus, its moments integrated over the section's two meridian pieces and the chord to 40 digits: the angles there are arc tangents the expression grammar has no word for, so they are written as numbers. Open CASCADE's chamfer of a cylinder against a sphere is a B-spline surface walked along the edge, not the exact surface, so no probe sits on it: two sit a tenth of the size either side of its middle, and its volume is 1.1e-7 and its area 6.8e-8 relative off the closed forms, which Arris matches to rounding; the measure tolerances are widened to cover the walk, under the 1e-6 ADR-0015 asks of a claimed difference.

analytic.occt_walked: Open CASCADE's chamfer of a cylinder against a sphere along a parallel is a B-spline surface walked along the edge, so its own STEP has a NURBS face beside the cylinder and the sphere, whose pairs the checker's S5 leaves undecided

occt_step_refused.why: Open CASCADE's chamfer of a cylinder against a sphere is a walked B-spline surface, and its own STEP writes that face with a bound whose walk in (u, v) jumps at a vertex where two of its edges meet, not along a singular row (#145's bound #146 at #24), as for blend/turned-shoulder-chamfer: the reader refuses the file as an open loop. Whether the file's pcurves or the reader's rule is at fault is not classified (docs/BACKLOG.md)
